evidence: Our operations are dependent on digital technologies and services, including systems operated by third parties that include embedded artificial intelligence (AI)
Our business has in the past and could in the future be negatively affected by security incidents and systems disruptions
Our operations have been and will continue to be subject to cyberattacks and other disruptions to our information systems that could have a material adverse impact on our business
ai_positioning.summary: MTX adopte une posture défensive vis-à-vis de l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques de cybersécurité et de disruption des systèmes plutôt que sur les opportunités. La société dépend de technologies IA tierces sans développer ses propres capacités.
